UI_Elements.UPGRADE_FAILED_PREAMBLE: Your dropship cannot be changed until you resolve the following issues:
UI_Elements.UPGRADE_FAILED_DESC: Cancel active ship upgrades or readying mechs in the timeline view from the main screen. Store active units or cancel reading actions to reduce the hangar count to match the new dropship. Dismiss pilots that exceed the berth limit on the new dropship. Do not navigate away from the current star system until you resolve these actions. This dialog will repeat each day until the conditions are cleared. You cannot cancel the dropship upgrade.
